title: The Buyer Persona Test That Actually Changes Marketing
description: If your target is “anyone who could buy,” the real problem is not advertising yet—it is definition. Learn how needs, context, channels, and observed behavior turn a buyer persona into an operating tool.
cta: Next: what customers are really buying beyond the product itself.
